name: Tempester 1.6.3.0-a (test)
description: 1.6.2.0 plus n°31 and n°32, a test image for the coordinator (no version digit of its own: the screens still show 1.6.2.0). n°31: the two Real Time FX ribbons over MIDI on Remote Pad IN, CC 108/109 = ribbon 1/2 touched at position 0-127, CC 110/111 = released, CC 112/113 = pressure 0-127, doing exactly what the physical ribbon does (Note FX, Beat FX in 16 Beats, Latch, the FX3/FX4 bank); physical ribbon moves are sent back on Remote Pad OUT as CC 108/109 = position and CC 110/111 = 0 on release (remote moves are not echoed). n°32: System, Foot Pedals, Pedal 1/2 Assignment in a switch mode goes on to « Pad 1 » ... « Pad 16 »: the footswitch presses and releases that panel pad (velocity = Fixed Level Velocity). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
